correctness.rationale: For k>=3 an induced forest of complete multipartite graph lies in one part or has a unique one-vertex center in a second part; this yields exact coefficients. A transfer from part size b>=2 to a>=b gives q(C(a,k-2)-C(b-1,k-2)) + a(b-1)/(k-2)(C(a-1,k-3)-C(b-2,k-3)) >=0, with strict third/fourth coefficients as claimed. The explicit K_(4,1^s) cubic defect is (4s^3-43s^2-41s-20)/2, positive for every s>=12. Independent integer-partition generator exhaustively checked all 898 multi-part profiles for 2<=N<=16: the unique non-log-concave type is N=16 and (1^12,4), coefficients [1,16,120,76,49,12] and deficit 104. Independently checked coefficientwise majorization for all 898 profiles. These finite results are exhaustive only through N=16; infinite family uses algebra.
